recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality, taste, freshness, and preparation.
recommendations.action: Implement a comprehensive kitchen audit, including ingredient sourcing review, standardized recipe adherence checks, and regular taste tests by management. Provide targeted training for kitchen staff on consistency and quality control.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in customer satisfaction with food, leading to higher repeat visits and positive word-of-mouth.

recommendations.issue: Negative staff interactions, including poor attitude, unhelpfulness, and lack of attentiveness.
recommendations.action: Develop and implement a mandatory customer service training program for all front-of-house staff, focusing on positive attitude, proactive attentiveness, and conflict resolution. Consider incentive programs for excellent service and review staffing levels during peak hours.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced customer experience, increased positive reviews regarding service, and improved staff morale.

recommendations.issue: Customers perceive prices as too high, indicating poor value for money.
recommendations.action: Conduct a competitive pricing analysis and evaluate current menu item portion sizes and ingredient costs. Consider introducing value-oriented specials, combo deals, or slightly adjusting portion sizes/pricing to better align with customer expectations and market value. Clearly communicate the quality and value of ingredients.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved perception of value, potentially increasing order volume and customer loyalty, while maintaining profitability.

recommendations.issue: Long wait times for seating, ordering, and food delivery.
recommendations.action: Optimize kitchen workflow and staffing schedules to match peak demand. Implement a digital waitlist system or reservation tool. Train staff on efficient order taking and table turnover. Consider pre-bussing or assigning specific roles during busy periods.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduced customer frustration, improved table turnover, and a smoother dining experience, leading to higher customer satisfaction.

recommendations.action: Conduct a walk-through audit of the dining area to identify outdated decor, maintenance needs, and potential noise issues. Implement a phased refresh plan for decor, address lighting and music levels, and ensure regular maintenance.
recommendations.expected_impact: A more pleasant and inviting dining environment, enhancing the overall customer experience and encouraging longer stays.

recommendations.issue: General dissatisfaction from minor operational shortcomings not fitting specific categories.
recommendations.action: Implement a daily pre-opening checklist for all areas (front and back of house) to ensure all operational details are covered. Encourage staff to proactively identify and resolve minor issues before they impact customers.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in minor complaints and an overall improvement in the consistency of the customer experience.

recommendations.action: Establish and enforce a detailed daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning schedule for all areas, including restrooms, dining surfaces, and kitchen. Assign specific staff responsibilities and conduct regular spot checks.
recommendations.expected_impact: A consistently clean and hygienic environment, preventing negative health perceptions and improving customer comfort.
